name: agentfeed-mpp
description: MPP solana/charge layer for AgentFeed. Isolated dependency tree: mppx pins express>=5 as peerOptional and AgentFeed runs express 4, so these deps must NOT be installed into the parent tree.
//patch-package: Production dependency, not dev: the postinstall applies the @solana/mpp preflightCommitment patch, and production installs with --omit=dev. As a devDependency the postinstall exits 127 and the install completes UNPATCHED.
